profiles.name: Tan Kok Wai
profiles.description: Tan Kok Wai represents Cheras, Kuala Lumpur, in the Dewan Rakyat. A DAP member.

profiles.name: Wan Azizah Wan Ismail
profiles.description: Wan Azizah Wan Ismail represents Bandar Tun Razak, Kuala Lumpur, in the Dewan Rakyat. A PKR member.

profiles.name: Radzi Jidin
profiles.description: Radzi Jidin represents Putrajaya, Putrajaya, in the Dewan Rakyat. A Bersatu member.
profiles.affiliation_note: The CSA report explicitly says Bersatu remains in opposition. The party is not attached to PN in the existing hierarchy, and budget cooperation is not classified as joining government.

milestones.title: Support Supply Bill 2027 under the confidence-and-supply agreement
milestones.description: Signed the agreement to support the 2027 Supply Bill.
milestones.progress_note: Signing is confirmed; subsequent voting and budget passage were not verified.

milestones.title: Present RM150 school vouchers to 600 Bandar Tun Razak students
milestones.description: Wan Azizah presented RM90,000 in vouchers through an Amanah Ikhtiar Malaysia programme for primary and secondary pupils.
milestones.progress_note: Achieved covers the documented voucher handover with AIM. It does not verify every redemption or imply that all students in the constituency received aid.

milestones.title: Support education savings and supplies for 43 eKasih students
milestones.description: The Sejahtera MADANI education programme reported SSPN certificates worth RM500 and RM100 school-supply vouchers for each of 43 students.
milestones.progress_note: The report confirms this handover. Wan Azizah explicitly tied expansion to priorities and available resources; no universal entitlement or future intake target is inferred.

methodology: Dated public commitments, documented activities and limited delivery reports are distinct. An evidence-only record has no invented earlier promise. Status is tied to its evidence snapshot and shared agency responsibility is explicit. Historical activity is not a live November performance measurement. Allocations, attendance, sales orders and unrelated programme ratios are not completion percentages. Additional research may extend this initial pass.
